messages:
Zoe L: Heads-up — the sampleapp onboarding flow is failing for new users when using the JS SDK v1.8.2. REST calls succeed. Repro: `yarn start` -> click 'Import creds' -> UI spins and never completes.
Zoe L: Console shows: `Unhandled rejection: StatusCodeError: 401 Unauthorized` but the exact same payload via curl returns 200.
Sam K: can you paste the sdk request payload + headers you saw?
Zoe L: sure, minimal repro:
```js
// sdk call
client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-7b', prompt: 'hi' })
```
Headers from the SDK request (logged):
```
authorization: Bearer xxxxx
user-agent: RedwoodJS/1.8.2
x-redwood-client: MISSING
```
Curl that works:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "X-Redwood-Client: sampleapp/1" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-7b","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Andre P: interesting — if the server branches on X-Redwood-Client to select logic (legacy vs new routing) then missing header could hit a different codepath. Also: SDK appears to send `model` but some admin routes expect `model_id` (param naming drift).
Zoe L: another thing: SDK client is retrying on 401 with exponential backoff. So the UI keeps retrying forever. The curl returns 401 once and then user fixes creds; SDK hides the error. REST client does NOT retry 401.
Sam K: whoa. SDK should never retry 401. That middleware config is wrong — retry should be for network/server (502/503/504) and 429 for idempotent requests only. I'll open an issue.
dx-bot: Incident 9876 created by Sam K — "SDK: retry-on-401 causing onboarding hang"
Jen M: I'll take the SDK PR to stop retrying on 4xx (except 429) and add a passthrough for unknown headers so sampleapp's X-Redwood-Client isn't dropped. Andre, can you add the admin.listModels binding to the node SDK and normalize `model`/`model_id`/`modelName`?
Andre P: yep — admin.listModels is present on the HTTP API but missing from the SDK surface. I'll add an adapter that accepts any of those names and maps to `model_id` before sending. Also will add an optional `idempotency_key` param that the REST supports (important for create routes).
Zoe L: small request: add a devex smoke test in sampleapp that runs the onboarding path with an invalid key to assert we surface 401 immediately (no retry spinner). That would catch regressions.
Sam K: agreed. timeline?
Jen M: opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2134 . Will include retry-middleware change + header passthrough + smoke test. CI should run in ~30m. ETA merge EOD tomorrow if green.
Zoe L: awesome — I can validate with the failing repro once the PR is staged. Posting full HAR dump to the issue and the curl above. Thanks! :tada:
